India's aviation sector is experiencing rapid growth! Just 10 years ago, India had only 74 operational airports. Today, that number has reached 157, and by 2047, India aims to expand this to 350-400 airports! This is part of the ambitious UDAN Scheme (Ude Desh Ka Aam Nagrik), connecting regional areas with new airports and air routes.
Key Achievements:
In just 10 years, India has built twice the number of airports compared to the last 70 years.
Domestic travelers increased from 60 million (2014) to 164 million (2024).
